$Comment: What a player sees and hears when an achievement's rewards are paid to them.
It fires both for an achievement that settles as it is earned and for one whose reward the
player came back to collect. 'collected' tells them apart (true for the collect), which is
what the Variants entry below reads: an achievement that settled at once already had its
achievement.unlocked notice, so only a collect is announced here.
This is the library's own neutral default. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its
own pack replaces it, and a server owner can do the same from the owner layer.
The moment carries 'achievement' (its id), 'title' (its name in the reader's language),
'points', 'collected', the outcome as 'granted' / 'queued' / 'failed' reward counts, and
anything the mod that catalogued it attached under its own names. 'player' is always the
name of who was paid. Add a Sound group to the Variants entry to give collecting a jingle.
